title: kelleria dieffenbachii
intro: Kelleria dieffenbachii, commonly known as the "dieffenbachia," is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is known for its large, showy leaves and ability to purify the air by removing toxins such as formaldehyde and xylene. The health benefits of dieffenbachia include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of dieffenbachia include its ability to reduce swelling and pain, and its bioactive constituents, including dihydroberberine and protoberberine alkaloids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
